
I would like you to reverse engineer a gate-level netlist back to its original RTL description.
The netlist was synthesized from a Verilog RTL design.

Please create an equivalent, clean, and readable RTL description that implements the same functionality.
Your RTL should be written in standard Verilog or SystemVerilog using best practices.

The module should be named 'TopModule' with the following interface:
clk, in, areset, out

Gate-level netlist:
```verilog

module RefModule(clk, in, areset, out);
  wire _00_;
  wire _01_;
  wire _02_;

  wire _04_;
  wire _05_;
  input areset;
  wire areset;
  input clk;
  wire clk;
  input in;
  wire in;
  wire [1:0] next;
  output out;
  wire out;
  wire [1:0] state;
  NOT _06_ (
    .A(state[1]),
    .Y(_03_)
  );
  NOT _07_ (
    .A(in),
    .Y(_04_)
  );
  NAND _08_ (
    .A(state[0]),
    .B(state[1]),
    .Y(_05_)
  );
  NOT _09_ (
    .A(_05_),
    .Y(out)
  );
  NOR _10_ (
    .A(state[0]),
    .B(_03_),
    .Y(_00_)
  );
  NAND _11_ (
    .A(in),
    .B(_00_),
    .Y(_01_)
  );
  NAND _12_ (
    .A(state[0]),
    .B(_04_),
    .Y(_02_)
  );
  NAND _13_ (
    .A(_01_),
    .B(_02_),
    .Y(next[1])
  );
  BUF _14_ (
    .A(in),
    .Y(next[0])
  );
  DFFSR _15_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(next[0]),
    .Q(state[0]),
    .R(areset),
    .S(1'h0)
  );
  DFFSR _16_ (
    .C(clk),
    .D(next[1]),
    .Q(state[1]),
    .R(areset),
    .S(1'h0)
  );
endmodule
```
